title: run.skill.md Phase 7 commit precedes Phase 9 harness artifacts, leaving them uncommitted at run exit
description: run.skill.md calls git_commit in Phase 7, before Phase 9 creates the post-candidate-tag harness artifacts: the run file candidate_tag field update, the signal status advance to 'candidate', and the signal index update. These three files are left uncommitted when the run completes. A manual chore commit is required after every successful run to avoid orphaned working-tree changes.
proposed_resolution: Either (a) move the git_commit call to after Phase 9's Signal Status Update and event file write, so all artifacts are included in a single commit; or (b) add an explicit 'commit harness artifacts' step at the end of Phase 10 covering the run file, signal file, and index. Option (a) is simpler but requires moving Phase 7 to Phase 10+. See also signal a1000066 which proposes amending the existing commit rather than creating a new one.
